description: Recurring and agentic task registry for MasterIndex entities.

notes: Use entry ids from current/index.json as task target keys.
Tasks are intentionally stored outside the core inventory file.

entityCoveragePolicy.appliesTo: Every current/index.json entities[].id, including entities with an empty entryTasks array.
requiredBehavior: On each six-hour cycle, verify the entity's local repository or service and record a gap or ambiguity when it cannot be checked.
On each daily cycle, refresh observed entity facts in current/index.json first, then current/inventory.md when its narrative is affected.
Before acting, read current/handoffs/index.json and apply active directives targeted to the entity or to all entities.
Do not create or alter an entry-specific task merely because the coverage policy ran.

globalTasks.name: MasterIndex refresh
globalTasks.purpose: Refresh the shared inventory baseline and preserve schema stability.

pickledballs-app.name: PickledBalls link and release check
pickledballs-app.purpose: Watch release posture and public links for the PickledBalls app and website.
expectedOutputs: Updated release notes in the inventory

qross-app.name: Qross release check
qross-app.purpose: Track release-state changes and any new public links for Qross.

nagz-app.name: Nagz release check
nagz-app.purpose: Track ASC release-state changes and discover any public app page for Nagz.

obo-ios-app.name: Flasherz Kids release check
obo-ios-app.purpose: Watch for App Store publication and link availability for Flasherz Kids.
expectedOutputs: Updated Flasherz Kids links or release notes

workinon-app.name: workin On release check
workinon-app.purpose: Check whether a public App Store page becomes available for workin On.

famster-app.name: Famster link check
famster-app.purpose: Validate the backend domain and discover any public app or marketing links for Famster.

burfords-app.name: 100 Burfords public page check
burfords-app.purpose: Keep the verified App Store page current and watch for a dedicated website.

nagzerver-backend.name: nagzerver health check
nagzerver-backend.purpose: Confirm the shared backend remains reachable and linked correctly in the index.
expectedOutputs: Updated backend status if it changes

server-monitor-service.name: server-monitor link check
server-monitor-service.purpose: Keep the monitoring service link current and note if a matching public app page appears.

app-feedback-inbox.name: App Feedback operational check
app-feedback-inbox.purpose: Verify the local dashboard, two-hour collector, deduplication ledger, screenshot preservation, and collection error count without exporting tester data.
expectedOutputs: Updated App Feedback operational facts or a recorded gap
